sum: MBody AI Ltd. designs and develops embodied artificial intelligence software for autonomous workforce and operational automation. Its flagship platform, the MBody AI Orchestrator is an AI-driven enterprise software platform that monitors, coordinates and manages robotic and sensor fleets to optimize physical work operations. Its platform provides perception AI for computer vision and environmental understanding, cognitive AI for adaptive decision-making, and learning AI for continuous on-site machine learning. Its platform also provides dynamic task and route optimization, along with fleet intelligence and coordination across multi-unit operations. The company serves the hospitality, office, warehouse, and healthcare sectors, supporting applications such as facility maintenance, workspace cleaning, autonomous logistics, inventory management, and sanitation. MBody AI Ltd. was founded in 2004 and is based in Mississauga, Canada.
